title: HomeGuard Contents Services Schedule — Pack-Out and In-Home Moving
content:
**HomeGuard Homeowners Policy — contents services: pack-out, storage and moving within the home**

| Dwelling payment entries on the claim | Service priced | Pack-out allowance |
|---|---|---|
| At least one, together carrying a replacement-cost value of 10000.00 or more | Packing out and storing the contents | 5 percent of the contents replacement-cost value |
| At least one, together carrying a replacement-cost value below 10000.00 | Moving the contents within the home | 2 percent of the contents replacement-cost value |
| None | — | None |

**Clause.** A pack-out allowance is added at a percentage of the contents replacement-cost value: 5 percent for packing out and storing the contents when the claim's dwelling payment entries carry a replacement-cost value of at least 10000.00, 2 percent for moving the contents within the home when a dwelling payment entry stands with a replacement-cost value below 10000.00, and nothing when the claim has no dwelling payment entry.

**Readings from the claim file**

1. The dwelling payment entries are the payment entries on the dwelling coverage part of the same claim, of any property class and any kind of payment; their replacement-cost values are taken together. A dwelling repeated-seepage or other denial entry is not a dwelling payment entry.
2. The contents replacement-cost value is the one recorded on the claim's actual-cash-value initial payment entry for personal property.
3. The allowance, taken on the contents replacement-cost value, is added to the contents supplemental before the floor at 0.00 and the single rounding to the cent.

**Boundary.** Dwelling payment entries carrying exactly 10000.00 take the 5 percent pack-out and storage allowance; 9999.99 takes the 2 percent in-home allowance.

**Hypothetical schedule applications**

- Dwelling payment entries of 8000.00 and 4500.00 on the claim, together 12500.00; contents replacement-cost value 6000.00: 5 percent, 300.00.
- One dwelling payment entry of 7200.00; contents replacement-cost value 6000.00: 2 percent, 120.00.
- No dwelling payment entry on the claim, the dwelling damage standing only as a denial entry; contents replacement-cost value 6000.00: no pack-out allowance.
